lines.text: Rover! You're back.
We received word from the northern village. They said you helped hold back the monster attack.
Only the first wave. The danger hasn't passed.
The monsters are still gathering, and the mana disturbance remains.
I was afraid you'd say that.
Still, what you've done has given the villagers hope.
I've seen how you fight, Rover. More importantly, I've seen how willing you are to help strangers.
So I'd like to ask something of you.
Go on.
Will you help protect our villages until we discover what's causing all of this?
I won't ask you to carry the burden alone.
The villagers will continue to stand and fight beside you.
But we need someone capable of leading the effort.
...You place a lot of trust in someone you barely know.
Maybe.
But you've already proven more trustworthy than many people I've known for years.
Alright.
I'll help protect the villages and find the source of these disturbances.
Thank you, Rover.
Then let's prepare for whatever comes next.
